name: ironwallengraving-products
description: Production product catalog table. Stores sellable product/color variant records, pricing, stock snapshot fields, catalog visibility, SEO slugs, image metadata, and product family grouping data.

ProductId.description: Primary key for a product record. This key is capitalized because the DynamoDB table hash key is defined as ProductId.

recordType.description: Constant marker value of product used by the catalog listing GSI.

slug.description: URL-friendly unique product slug used for product detail lookups.

category.description: Optional product category used for organization and filtering.

tags.description: Optional list of catalog tags assigned to the product.

price.description: Effective customer price currently shown and charged for the product.

basePrice.description: Regular product price before any sale price is applied.

salePrice.description: Optional sale price used when the product is on sale.

isOnSale.description: Whether sale pricing should be used for this product.

percentOff.description: Computed discount percentage shown for sale products.

cost.description: Optional internal product cost used for owner/admin reporting.

shipping.description: Optional product-level shipping dimensions and weight.

lengthIn.description: Product package length contribution in inches.

widthIn.description: Product package width contribution in inches.

heightIn.description: Product package height contribution in inches.

stockQuantity.description: Current on-hand inventory quantity for the product.

inStock.description: Whether the product is currently considered available to buy.

featured.description: Whether the product should be highlighted in featured catalog surfaces.

isHidden.description: Whether the product should be hidden from public catalog views.

publishAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp after which the product may be publicly visible.

sku.description: Optional stock keeping unit for fulfillment and owner reference.

mainImageKey.description: S3 object key for the primary product image.

images.description: Stored product image metadata and generated variants.

key.description: S3 object key for the original image.

fileName.description: Original or display file name for the image.

altText.description: Optional accessibility alt text for the image.

variants.description: Generated image variants for responsive display.

key.description: S3 object key for the generated variant.

fileName.description: File name for the generated variant.

contentType.description: MIME type for the generated variant.

unitsSold.description: Total units sold for this product.

grossRevenue.description: Total gross revenue attributed to this product.

lastSoldAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp for the most recent sale.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the product record was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the product record was last updated.

familyId.description: Stable product family identifier used to group color variants.

familySlug.description: URL-friendly family slug shared by related product variants.

colorKey.description: Stable machine key for this product color variant.

colorLabel.description: Customer-facing color label for this product variant.

colorSlug.description: URL-friendly color slug for this product variant.

isDefaultColor.description: Whether this variant is the default color shown for the product family.

indexes.name: primary
indexes.description: Direct lookup of one product record by product id.

indexes.name: slug-index
indexes.description: Lookup a product by its public URL slug.

indexes.name: recordType-updatedAt-index
indexes.description: Query product records for catalog/admin listings ordered by update time.

replication.description: Production DynamoDB table replicated as a Global Table between the primary region and DR region. Writes in either region replicate to the other region.

name: ironwallengraving-posts
description: Production content table for site posts. Stores post metadata, public visibility controls, feature flags, post images, and content bodies.

postId.description: Primary key for a post record.

recordType.description: Constant marker value of post used by the all-posts listing GSI.

postType.description: Post classification used by the post-type listing GSI.

category.description: Optional category label for the post.

isHidden.description: Whether the post should be hidden from public post listings.

featured.description: Whether the post should be highlighted in featured content surfaces.

featureExpiresAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp after which the featured flag should no longer be treated as active.

mainImageKey.description: S3 object key for the primary post image.

images.description: Stored post image metadata and generated variants.

key.description: S3 object key for the original image.

fileName.description: Original or display file name for the image.

altText.description: Optional accessibility alt text for the image.

variants.description: Generated image variants for responsive display.

key.description: S3 object key for the generated variant.

fileName.description: File name for the generated variant.

contentType.description: MIME type for the generated variant.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the post was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the post was last updated.

indexes.name: primary
indexes.description: Direct lookup of one post by post id.

indexes.name: recordType-createdAt-index
indexes.description: Query all posts newest-first without scanning the table.

indexes.name: postType-createdAt-index
indexes.description: Query posts of a specific post type newest-first.

replication.description: Production DynamoDB table replicated as a Global Table between the primary region and DR region. Writes in either region replicate to the other region.

name: ironwallengraving-carts
description: Production checkout cart table. Stores in-progress carts, checkout pricing snapshots, shipping quotes, payment linkage, inventory reservation pointers, and cart TTL cleanup metadata.

source.description: Optional source label indicating where the cart originated.

items.description: Raw cart lines requested by the customer.

productId.description: Product id for the line item.

productName.description: Optional denormalized product name captured with the cart line.

familySlug.description: Optional product family slug captured with the cart line.

colorKey.description: Optional product color key captured with the cart line.

colorLabel.description: Optional customer-facing color label captured with the cart line.

colorSlug.description: Optional product color slug captured with the cart line.

sku.description: Optional SKU captured with the cart line.

pricedItems.description: Validated priced item snapshot used for checkout totals.

productId.description: Product id for the priced line item.

productName.description: Product name at the time pricing was calculated.

productSlug.description: Product slug at the time pricing was calculated.

unitPrice.description: Unit price used for this checkout snapshot.

itemCount.description: Total quantity of items in the cart.

subtotal.description: Cart merchandise subtotal before shipping and tax.

status.description: Checkout lifecycle status for the cart.

paymentStatus.description: Payment status associated with the cart.

paymentProvider.description: Payment provider used for the cart, such as stripe.

paymentReferenceId.description: Provider payment reference id used to correlate checkout events.

orderId.description: Order id created from this cart once checkout completes.

shippingParcel.description: Package dimensions and weight snapshot used for rating.

massUnit.description: Mass unit sent to the shipping provider.

distanceUnit.description: Distance unit sent to the shipping provider.

shippingRates.description: Available customer-facing shipping rates returned during checkout.

shipmentId.description: Provider shipment id used to buy the label later.

provider.description: Shipping provider that produced the rate.

amount.description: Rate amount charged to the customer.

shippingSelection.description: The rate selected by the customer for checkout.

provider.description: Shipping provider for the selected rate.

shipmentId.description: Provider shipment id for the selected rate.

rateId.description: Provider rate id selected by the customer.

selectedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the customer selected this rate.

totalAmount.description: Total amount due including subtotal, shipping, and tax.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the cart was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the cart was last updated.

currentReservationId.description: Current inventory reservation id associated with this cart.

reservationVersion.description: Version counter for inventory reservation attempts on this cart.

paymentIntentId.description: Stripe payment intent id for the checkout session.

reservationExpiresAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the current inventory reservation expires.

reservationReleaseAfter.description: ISO-8601 timestamp after which an expired reservation may be released.

reservationFingerprint.description: Fingerprint tying the current pricing and reservation state together.

ttlExpiresAt.description: DynamoDB TTL epoch seconds for automatic cart cleanup.

indexes.name: primary
indexes.description: Direct lookup of one cart by cart id.

replication.description: Production DynamoDB table replicated as a Global Table between the primary region and DR region. Writes in either region replicate to the other region.

name: ironwallengraving-orders
description: Production order table. Stores completed checkout snapshots, payment references, fulfillment state, shipping label/tracking metadata, Stripe dispute metadata, and payment-completed side-effect markers.

recordType.description: Constant marker value of order used by the admin order listing GSI.

cartId.description: Cart id that produced this order.

items.description: Original cart items captured on the order.

productName.description: Optional product name captured with the item.

familySlug.description: Optional product family slug captured with the item.

colorKey.description: Optional product color key captured with the item.

colorLabel.description: Optional customer-facing color label captured with the item.

colorSlug.description: Optional product color slug captured with the item.

sku.description: Optional SKU captured with the item.

pricedItems.description: Priced checkout snapshot used to render the order and emails.

productId.description: Product id for the priced line.

itemCount.description: Total quantity of items in the order.

shippingAddress.description: Shipping address snapshot for the completed order.

shippingParcel.description: Package dimensions and weight snapshot used for label purchase.

massUnit.description: Mass unit sent to the shipping provider.

distanceUnit.description: Distance unit sent to the shipping provider.

provider.description: Shipping provider for the selected rate.

shipmentId.description: Provider shipment id for the selected rate.

rateId.description: Provider rate id selected by the customer.

selectedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the customer selected this rate.

paymentStatus.description: Payment status for the completed order.

fulfillmentStatus.description: Fulfillment lifecycle status for the order.

paymentProvider.description: Payment provider used for the order.

paymentReferenceId.description: Provider payment reference id used for idempotency and payment lookup.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the order record was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the order was last updated.

paymentCompletedEventPublishedAt.description: Side-effect marker timestamp indicating the payment-completed event was published to downstream workers.

shippedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the order was marked shipped.

shipmentNotificationStatus.description: Status of the customer shipment notification side effect.

shipmentNotificationQueuedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the shipment notification was queued.

shipmentNotificationSentAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the shipment notification was sent.

shipmentNotificationRecipient.description: Email address that received the shipment notification.

shipmentNotificationIntendedRecipient.description: Original intended customer email before any sandbox routing.

shipmentNotificationSubject.description: Subject line used for the shipment notification email.

shipmentNotificationSandboxRouted.description: Whether the shipment notification was routed to a sandbox/test recipient.

shipmentNotificationLastAttemptAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last shipment notification send attempt.

shipmentNotificationFailureReason.description: Most recent shipment notification failure reason.

transactionId.description: Provider transaction id for the purchased label.

labelUrl.description: URL to the purchased shipping label.

labelFileType.description: File type for the label document.

trackingNumber.description: Carrier tracking number returned with the label.

trackingUrl.description: Optional carrier tracking URL returned with the label.

serviceLevelName.description: Service level name for the purchased label.

serviceLevelToken.description: Service level token for the purchased label.

purchasedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the label was purchased.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when tracking was last updated.

stripePaymentIntentId.description: Stripe payment intent id associated with the order.

stripeChargeId.description: Stripe charge id associated with the order.

stripeDisputeId.description: Stripe dispute id currently associated with the order.

stripeDisputeStatus.description: Latest Stripe dispute status recorded for the order.

stripeDisputeEvidenceDueBy.description: Evidence deadline supplied by Stripe for the dispute.

stripeDisputeCreatedAt.description: Timestamp when the Stripe dispute was created.

stripeDisputeUpdatedAt.description: Timestamp when the Stripe dispute details were last updated.

stripeDisputeClosedAt.description: Timestamp when the Stripe dispute closed.

stripeDisputeFundsWithdrawnAt.description: Timestamp when disputed funds were withdrawn.

stripeDisputeFundsReinstatedAt.description: Timestamp when disputed funds were reinstated.

orderStatus.description: Owner-facing order status, such as ready_for_fulfillment or inventory_exception.

indexes.name: primary
indexes.description: Direct lookup of one order by order id.

indexes.name: recordType-createdAt-index
indexes.description: Admin order views query newest-first orders without changing the order primary key.

replication.description: Production DynamoDB table replicated as a Global Table between the primary region and DR region. Writes in either region replicate to the other region.

name: ironwallengraving-site-settings
description: Production singleton-style site settings table. Stores storefront banner settings and Shippo account/origin configuration used by checkout and fulfillment.

settingKey.description: Primary key for a site settings record. The current application uses a stable singleton settings key.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the settings record was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the settings record was last updated.

enabled.description: Whether the storefront banner is enabled.

expiresAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp after which the banner is no longer active.

shippoOrigin.description: Shipping origin address used when creating Shippo shipments.

name.description: Sender/contact name for the origin address.

status.description: Connection status for the Shippo account.

accountEmail.description: Optional email address for the connected Shippo account.

displayName.description: Optional display name for the connected Shippo account.

connectedAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp when Shippo was connected.

indexes.name: primary
indexes.description: Direct lookup of the site settings record by setting key.

replication.description: Production DynamoDB table replicated as a Global Table between the primary region and DR region. Writes in either region replicate to the other region.

name: ironwallengraving-inventory-ledger
description: Production immutable inventory movement ledger. Stores sale, reservation, release, and manual adjustment entries so stock changes can be audited and replayed.

ledgerId.description: Primary key for the immutable ledger entry.

recordType.description: Constant marker value of inventory-movement used by the chronological ledger GSI.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key used to avoid writing duplicate movement entries for the same source event.

movementType.description: Type of inventory movement, such as sale, reservation_hold, reservation_release, or manual_adjustment.

sourceEventType.description: Event or workflow that produced the movement.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the ledger entry was created.

lineCount.description: Number of product lines included in the movement.

totalQuantityDelta.description: Total inventory quantity delta across all movement lines.

productId.description: Product id affected by the inventory movement.

quantity.description: Absolute quantity involved in the movement.

quantityDelta.description: Signed inventory change for this product line.

sku.description: Optional SKU for the affected product.

productName.description: Optional product name captured for audit readability.

colorLabel.description: Optional customer-facing color label captured for audit readability.

stockBefore.description: Optional stock quantity before a manual adjustment.

stockAfter.description: Optional stock quantity after a manual adjustment.

orderId.description: Optional order id associated with the movement.

cartId.description: Optional cart id associated with the movement.

customerEmail.description: Optional customer email for sale movements.

paymentStatus.description: Optional payment status captured from the source order/event.

fulfillmentStatus.description: Optional fulfillment status captured from the source order/event.

paymentProvider.description: Optional payment provider captured from the source order/event.

paymentReferenceId.description: Optional payment provider reference id captured from the source order/event.

completedAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 checkout completion timestamp for sale movements.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for a manual adjustment.

note.description: Optional internal note for a manual adjustment.

createdBy.description: Optional actor identifier for a manual adjustment.

indexes.name: primary
indexes.description: Direct lookup of one immutable ledger entry by ledger id.

indexes.name: recordType-createdAt-index
indexes.description: Query the chronological inventory audit trail without scanning the table.

replication.description: Production DynamoDB table replicated as a Global Table between the primary region and DR region. Writes in either region replicate to the other region.

name: ironwallengraving-stripe-webhook-events
description: Production Stripe webhook idempotency and audit table. Stores delivery counts, processing leases, outcomes, related payment/order identifiers, and failure details.

eventId.description: Primary key using the Stripe event id.

recordType.description: Constant marker value of stripe-webhook-event used by the webhook audit GSI.

objectType.description: Stripe object type carried by the event.

objectId.description: Stripe object id carried by the event.

paymentIntentId.description: Related Stripe payment intent id when available.

chargeId.description: Related Stripe charge id when available.

disputeId.description: Related Stripe dispute id when available.

cartId.description: Related checkout cart id when the event can be tied back to a cart.

processingOutcome.description: Summary outcome written after processing succeeds.

relatedOrderId.description: Order id created or affected while processing the event.

deliveryCount.description: Number of times this Stripe event has been received.

receivedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this event was first received.

lastReceivedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this event was most recently received.

processedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when processing completed successfully.

failedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when processing last failed.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the webhook event log row was last updated.

processingLeaseOwner.description: Worker lease owner while an event is being processed.

processingLeaseExpiresAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the processing lease expires.

indexes.name: primary
indexes.description: Direct lookup and idempotency check by Stripe event id.

indexes.name: recordType-receivedAt-index
indexes.description: Query a newest-first Stripe webhook audit trail for admin health views.

replication.description: Production DynamoDB table replicated as a Global Table between the primary region and DR region. Writes in either region replicate to the other region.

name: ironwallengraving-payment-completed-outbox
description: Production durable outbox for payment-completed events. Stores pending/publishing/published worker records so downstream side effects can be retried safely and recovered during DR.

outboxId.description: Primary key for the outbox row. Payment-completed rows are keyed from the order id.

orderId.description: Order id for the payment-completed event.

cartId.description: Cart id for the payment-completed event.

payload.description: Serialized payment-completed event payload consumed by downstream workers.

status.description: Outbox lifecycle status such as pending, publishing, published, or failed.

attemptCount.description: Number of publish attempts made for this outbox row.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the outbox row was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the outbox row was last updated.

nextAttemptAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the row is eligible for the next publish attempt.

leaseOwner.description: Worker lease owner while the row is being published.

leaseExpiresAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the publishing lease expires.

lastAttemptAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent publish attempt.

publishedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the event was successfully published.

lastFailureReason.description: Most recent failure reason from publishing the outbox row.

expiresAt.description: DynamoDB TTL epoch seconds for cleanup of terminal outbox rows.

indexes.name: primary
indexes.description: Direct lookup of one outbox row by outbox id.

indexes.name: OutboxDueIndex
indexes.description: Query due pending work and stale publishing leases without scanning the outbox table.

replication.description: Production DynamoDB table replicated as a Global Table between the primary region and DR region. Writes in either region replicate to the other region.

name: ironwallengraving-inventory-reservations
description: Production inventory reservation table. Stores cart stock holds, release schedules, worker leases, and terminal cleanup metadata used to avoid overselling and safely release abandoned holds.

reservationId.description: Primary key for an inventory reservation.

cartId.description: Cart id that owns the reservation.

reservationVersion.description: Version counter for reservations created by the same cart.

status.description: Reservation lifecycle status such as reserved, cancel_pending, releasing, release_blocked, released, or consumed.

items.description: Merged product quantities held by the reservation.

productId.description: Product id held by the reservation.

sku.description: Optional SKU captured for the reserved product.

productName.description: Optional product name captured for the reserved product.

colorLabel.description: Optional customer-facing color label captured for the reserved product.

reservationFingerprint.description: Fingerprint tying the reservation to the cart/pricing state that created it.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the reservation was created.

expiresAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the reservation hold expires.

releaseAfter.description: ISO-8601 timestamp after which an expired reservation may be released.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the reservation was last updated.

nextAttemptAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the reservation is eligible for release/retry processing.

paymentIntentId.description: Stripe payment intent id associated with the reservation.

leaseOwner.description: Worker lease owner while release work is being performed.

leaseExpiresAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the release lease expires.

lastAttemptAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent release attempt.

releasedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the reservation was released.

consumedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the reservation was consumed by a completed order.

lastFailureReason.description: Most recent failure reason from reservation release processing.

ttlExpiresAt.description: DynamoDB TTL epoch seconds for cleanup of terminal reservation rows.

indexes.name: primary
indexes.description: Direct lookup of one inventory reservation by reservation id.

indexes.name: InventoryReservationDueIndex
indexes.description: Query due reserved/cancel-pending rows and stale releasing leases without scanning the reservation table.

replication.description: Production DynamoDB table replicated as a Global Table between the primary region and DR region. Writes in either region replicate to the other region.

name: ironwallengraving-owner-order-todos
description: Production owner work queue table. Stores durable owner-facing tasks created from paid orders and Stripe disputes, with enough denormalized order details to render a task list without rehydrating every order.

todoId.description: Primary key for the owner to-do item.

orderId.description: Order id associated with the owner task.

cartId.description: Cart id associated with the owner task.

customerEmail.description: Customer email associated with the task.

status.description: Task status, such as open or completed.

title.description: Human-readable task title for the owner UI.

details.description: Human-readable task details for owner review.

sourceEventType.description: Event type or workflow that created the task.

items.description: Order items copied onto the task for owner visibility.

productId.description: Product id for the order item.

paymentStatus.description: Payment status copied from the source order/event.

fulfillmentStatus.description: Fulfillment status copied from the source order/event.

paymentProvider.description: Payment provider copied from the source order/event.

paymentReferenceId.description: Payment provider reference id copied from the source order/event.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the task was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the task was last updated.

paymentCompletedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the related payment completed.

completedAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp when the owner task was completed.

indexes.name: primary
indexes.description: Direct lookup of one owner task by todo id.

indexes.name: status-createdAt-index
indexes.description: Query owner tasks by status, usually open first and newest-first.
